question: are there any cultural clubs at ramapo? like for south asian or caribbean students

body.answer:
Yes. Ramapo’s culturally based student organizations include [Students of Caribbean Ancestry (SOCA)](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/students-caribbean-ancestry-soca/) and [South Asian Club](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/). [15] SOCA promotes understanding of Caribbean culture, history and politics through weekly meetings and programs, and seeks to include all people of Caribbean ancestry. [12] South Asian Club aims to bring South Asians together and share awareness of South Asian culture. [9]

Other related options include [Naach](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/), a dance club teaching South Asian dances that welcomes anyone interested, [13] and [United Asian Association](https://archway.ramapo.edu/UAA/), which advocates for and educates about the Asian-Pacific Islander American diaspora. [7] Their categories are Student Organization (SOCA, South Asian Club, and United Asian Association) and Student Organization - Arts, Community, Cultural, Social (Naach). [2][3][4][7] The directory gives 7 clubs in these categories. [1] All clubs listed on the College page are open to students. [11]

Culture Club is not currently active, according to the page as of 6/12/25. [8] For help finding a group or starting one, contact the Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [11]

Sources: [1](https://archway.ramapo.edu/CultClub/) [2](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SOCA/) [3](https://archway.ramapo.edu/SAC/) [4](https://archway.ramapo.edu/Naach/) [7](https://archway.ramapo.edu/UAA/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/culture-club/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/south-asians-ramapo/) [11](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/students-caribbean-ancestry-soca/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/naach/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/oabc/home/you-belong-at-ramapo/)

question: Is there a community service club or volunteering org I can join? I'm a junior and never did anything like that and want to before I graduate

body.answer:
Yes. The Social Work Club is a student organization; its mission says it is a space for students to share ways to help society and learn about social issues, and invites people who feel inclined to help others. Membership is listed as lifetime. Club page: https://archway.ramapo.edu/SWCR/; email: socialwork@ramapo.edu. [2] All listed clubs are open to all students and welcome new members. [15]

For volunteering beyond a club, the Civic and Community Engagement Center (CCEC) page says opportunities are listed in the Daily Digest, In the Loop, and on Archway at https://archway.ramapo.edu/CCEC/club_signup; it also recommends contacting CCEC at ccec@ramapo.edu. [11] That page is from 2025, so its information is from a past year. CCEC is in SC-213; call (201) 684-7586. [11]

question: is there a christian fellowship or any faith based groups on campus

body.answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists these faith-based groups: Muslim Student Association (MSA), InterVarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF), Newman Catholic, Hillel, and Chabad; it also lists an Interfaith Prayer & Reflection Space in H-201. [10]

For Christian fellowship, IVCF is an interdenominational Christian community and welcomes everyone. It holds weekly Bible-study small groups and weekly large-group meetings; email ivcf@ramapo.edu to learn more. [8] Newman Catholic offers Mass, Bible studies, Newman Nights, OCIA classes, service opportunities, retreats, and spiritual direction, among other activities; contact campusministry@ramapo.edu or visit https://www.ramaponewman.com/. [1][9]

Hillel offers religious and cultural programs, including trips, holiday observances, lectures, films, and leadership opportunities; its programs are open to the college community. [7]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/ministries/newman-catholic/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/ministries/hillel/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/inter-varsity-christian-fellowship-ivcf/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/newman-catholic-group/) [10](https://www.ramapo.edu/oabc/home/you-belong-at-ramapo/)

question: arts clubs? theater, a cappella, art club, anything like that

[1] For more information on esports as a competitive sports club, see Intramural & Club Sports Info: https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx. [12]

Other gaming groups include Ramapo Girls in Gaming (https://archway.ramapo.edu/gaming/; rgg@ramapo.edu), which hosts meetings, events, game nights, and presentations for female-presenting people and allies who game. [5] Ramapo Smash Club (https://archway.ramapo.edu/SMASH/; smashclub@ramapo.edu) hosts meetings and events for students interested in Super Smash Brothers and other fighting games; its page also lists a Discord: https://discord.gg/YDcNVbJ. [3] Rhythm Game Club (https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/rhythm-game-club/; rrgc@ramapo.edu) welcomes players of all backgrounds, with no experience required. [6][8] Trading Card Game Club welcomes new, casual, and competitive players: https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/trading-card-game-club/; tcg@ramapo.edu. [9]

The college says all listed clubs are open to students. Contact the Center for Student Involvement for help finding or starting a club: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [7]
